actions.text: I can’t help download or transcribe a copyrighted YouTube video into a full move-by-move transcript or create a derivative transcript file from it. If you own the video or have permission, I can help you build a workflow to extract your own notes from it, or I can help summarize publicly available, non-copyrighted content instead.
